schema.text: Do you ride a bicycle (including e-bikes) or an e-scooter, your own or a shared one, at least once a week to get to places?

en.#Do you ride a bicycle (including e-bike: Do you ride a bicycle (including e-bikes) or an e-scooter, your own or a shared one, at least once a week to get to places?

it.#Do you ride a bicycle (including e-bike: Usi la bicicletta (anche elettrica) o il monopattino, tuoi o in sharing, almeno una volta alla settimana per i tuoi spostamenti?

fr.#Do you ride a bicycle (including e-bike: Utilisez-vous un vélo (y compris à assistance électrique) ou une trottinette électrique, personnel ou en libre-service, au moins une fois par semaine pour vos déplacements ?

de.#Do you ride a bicycle (including e-bike: Fahren Sie mindestens einmal pro Woche mit dem Fahrrad (auch E-Bike) oder einem E-Scooter, eigenem oder geteiltem, um irgendwohin zu gelangen?

tr.#Do you ride a bicycle (including e-bike: Bir yerlere gitmek için haftada en az bir kez, kendinize ait ya da paylaşımlı bir bisiklet (elektrikli bisikletler dahil) veya elektrikli scooter kullanıyor musunuz?

fa.#Do you ride a bicycle (including e-bike: آیا دست‌کم هفته‌ای یک بار برای رفت‌وآمد از دوچرخه (از جمله دوچرخهٔ برقی) یا اسکوتر برقی، شخصی یا اشتراکی، استفاده می‌کنید؟

hu.#Do you ride a bicycle (including e-bike: Legalább hetente egyszer használ kerékpárt (beleértve az elektromos kerékpárt is) vagy elektromos rollert – sajátot vagy közösségit –, hogy eljusson valahová?

ar.#Do you ride a bicycle (including e-bike: هل تستخدم دراجة هوائية (بما في ذلك الدراجات الكهربائية) أو سكوترًا كهربائيًا، خاصًا بك أو مشتركًا، مرة واحدة على الأقل في الأسبوع للتنقّل؟
